study_role: additional exploratory analyses after historical results; not preregistered

legacy_comparison.historical_labels: agreement only; not external ground truth
legacy_comparison.purpose: compare coding and level sensitivity on identical complete-person subsets; persist fuzzy centers and memberships

post_stop_scenarios.estimand: algebraic full-cohort sensitivity under hypothetical constant unobserved scores; no identified counterfactual or calibrated interval
post_stop_scenarios.parameter_basis: entire confirmed VAS scale on integer display grid; no clinical plausibility ranking or preferred scenario
post_stop_scenarios.output: aggregate curves and trapezoidal area bounds only; no individual imputation

shapelet_recovery.distance: minimum mean squared distance over consecutive observed prefix segments; raw VAS
shapelet_recovery.selection: training-only squared class-versus-rest mean-distance contrast divided by pooled distance variance
shapelet_recovery.classifier: training-standardized logistic regression C=1; no hyperparameter search
shapelet_recovery.reference: full-interval kmeans partition fit on outer training persons; test reference nearest training center
shapelet_recovery.baseline: training majority partition and logistic recovery from the same raw prefix
shapelet_recovery.role: internal retrospective partition recovery; no clinical labels or validated phenotype

baseline_recovery.pool: development only for every baseline comparison
baseline_recovery.preprocessing: fit median/mode imputation, category encoding and standardization on training persons only
baseline_recovery.classifier: logistic C=1 with training-only preprocessing; majority baseline
baseline_recovery.reference: training-defined full-interval partition; not clinical truth
baseline_recovery.comparison: questionnaire versus questionnaire plus resting candidates on identical eligible people and folds
baseline_recovery.role: development-only candidate feasibility; baseline physiological classification remains unvalidated

candidate_models.shared_support_rule: identical person, unique selected E sources, same acquisition date, identical VAS minute contract; nominal recording-start alignment only
candidate_models.timing_evidence: same date does not establish continuous cross-device synchronization
candidate_models.hb_scale: within-person block SD; not absolute concentration
candidate_models.egg_channel_aggregation: two available channels with at least two retained continuous spectral segments each; equal mean of each descriptor
candidate_models.egg_predictor_role: spectral argmax including boundary maxima, log broad-band power and neutral band ratio; not accepted gastric rhythm
candidate_models.egg_hb_model: Hb within-person standardized candidate on each EGG descriptor plus person and categorical block fixed effects
candidate_models.joint_model: VAS on candidate HR, candidate RR-RMSSD and each Hb descriptor plus person and categorical block fixed effects
candidate_models.joint_base: VAS on candidate HR and candidate RR-RMSSD on the exact same rows
candidate_models.joint_comparison: in-sample residual SSE difference only; not predictive gain or causal effect
candidate_models.interval_role: whole-person percentile descriptive stability; no validated CI
candidate_models.surrogate: not executed: within-person time exchangeability has not been established

scientific_blockers_retained.clinical_HRV: no independent R-peak and normal-beat/NN reference
scientific_blockers_retained.primary_physiology_inference: independent target validation incomplete; retain all primary p/q as missing
scientific_blockers_retained.markov: no evidence-supported state thresholds; transition regression not implemented
scientific_blockers_retained.phase_directional_coupling: phase quality and E05 physiological validity unresolved
scientific_blockers_retained.clinically_justified_dropout_shift: no supported counterfactual or clinical shift parameters; exhaustive algebraic grid is diagnostic only
